label: Transformer over 20-s patches, 5-member ensemble on 3 banks (round 2, D2)
family_label: Attention (transformer encoder over 20-s patch tokens), 5-member ensemble

compute.notes: 5 members x (12 + 24) epochs on 86,400 trips (3 banks), RTX 3080 shared by up to 8 jobs: 63 min wall per member (5.21 GPU-h in all), process CPU ~1.0 h per member (4.88 h). The v1.0 rungs (1.64 single-thread CPU-h) are the incumbent's.

feature_engineering: as v1.0 trace_transformer r2 (arms_trace/common/tracelib.py, unchanged): 5-s block means of the 1 Hz trace (12 channels), 4-block (20-s) patch tokens, spec (49) and road load (5) standardised with train101 statistics, log distance / duration, physics anchor E_phys recomputed from the trace inputs (bake.e_phys_from_trace, declared), target log(y / E_phys), log(E_phys / A0) as an input. Ensemble: mean log-quantile per level over the 5 members, pred = exp(mean log q50) (round2/arms/common/enslib.py)
rule: keep a rung if its full frozen sim val skill beats the incumbent by > 0.01 AND its dev D16 is not worse than the incumbent's by more than 0.01 (the bake-off's rule; PREREG.md section 0). Physics rungs: PREREG.md section 2.
